Respond ONLY in valid JSON with these exact fields: ai_insights_en (English strategic insights 2-3 sentences about AI/tech industry implications), ai_insights_kr (Korean strategic insights 2-3 sentences), ai_insights_cn (Chinese strategic insights 2-3 sentences), key_terms (array of 2-3 important Chinese terms, each with: term, pinyin with tone marks, explanation_kr, explanation_en, explanation_zh). 제목: ' + $json.title_cn + '
요약: ' + ($json.summary_cn || $json.summary_kr || '') + '
본문: ' + ($json.content_cn ? $json.content_cn.substring(0, 3000) : '') }], max_tokens: 1000, temperature: 0.3 }) }}

    content: "너는 한국어 AI 뉴스 에디터다. 번역 초안을 개선하라:

4. 잡음 토큰 제거

요약: " + ($json.summary_kr||'') + "

요약: ..."
  }],
  max_tokens: 600,
  temperature: 0.2
}) }}
